courses.title: (In-person) Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction
courses.description: The eight-week MBSR course taught by Christiane Wolf at the Santa Monica Meditation Center, meeting on Tuesday evenings with a daylong at the Benedict Canyon Retreat House. Students learn mindfulness practices for meeting stress and difficulty in daily life.

free_resources.title: Mindful Support: Nurturing the Heart
free_resources.description: A weekly guided meditation on Monday evenings with JD Lloyd, in person in Santa Monica and on Zoom, practising relaxation, a calm mind and loving-kindness. Offered by donation and open to newcomers; registration is needed.

free_resources.title: Recovery Dharma @ InsightLA
free_resources.description: A peer-led weekly meeting at the Santa Monica Meditation Center for people in recovery from addiction, built on Buddhist principles. Each meeting has a guided meditation, a reading or speaker and open sharing, by donation.
